"""Validation helpers for widgetkit."""
import re


def validate_email(address):
    if not address or "@" not in address:
        return False
    local, _, domain = address.partition("@")
    if not local or not domain or "." not in domain:
        return False
    return bool(re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", address))


def validate_phone(number):
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", number)
    return len(digits) in (10, 11)


def validate_zip(code):
    return bool(re.match(r"^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$", code))


def validate_age(age, minimum=0, maximum=150):
    return minimum <= age <= maximum


def validate_password_strength(password):
```bash
    if len(password) < 8:
        return False
    has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
    has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
    has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit
```

"""Validation helpers for widgetkit."""
import re


def validate_email(address: str) -> bool:
    if not address or "@" not in address:
        return False
    local, _, domain = address.partition("@")
    if not local or not domain or "." not in domain:
        return False
    return bool(re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", address))


def validate_phone(number: str) -> bool:
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", number)
    return len(digits) in (10, 11)


def validate_zip(code: str) -> bool:
    return bool(re.match(r"^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$", code))


def validate_age(age: int, minimum: int = 0, maximum: int = 150) -> bool:
    return minimum <= age <= maximum


def validate_password_strength(password: str) -> bool:
    if len(password) < 8:
        return False
    has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
    has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
    has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)

import re


def validate_email(address: str) -> bool:
    if not address or "@" not in address:
        return False
    local, _, domain = address.partition("@")
    if not local or not domain or "." not in domain:
        return False
    return bool(re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", address))


def validate_phone(number: str) -> bool:
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", number)
    return len(digits) in (10, 11)


def validate_zip(code: str) -> bool:
    return bool(re.match(r"^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$", code))


def validate_age(age: int, minimum: int = 0, maximum: int = 150) -> bool:
    return minimum <= age <= maximum


def validate_password_strength(password: str) -> bool:
    if len(password) < 8:
        return False
    has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
    has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
    has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit

"""Formatting helpers for widgetkit."""
from typing import Optional


def format_currency(amount: float, currency: str = "USD") -> str:
    symbols = {"USD": "$", "EUR": "\u20ac", "GBP": "\u00a3"}
    symbol = symbols.get(currency, currency + " ")
    return f"{symbol}{amount:,.2f}"


def format_date(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> str:
    return f"{year:04d}-{month:02d}-{day:02d}"


def format_name(first: str, last: str, middle: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    if middle:
        return f"{first} {middle[0]}. {last}"
    return f"{first} {last}"


def truncate(text: str, length: int = 80, suffix: str = "...") -> str:
    if len(text) <= length:
        return text
    return text[: length - len(suffix)] + suffix


def pluralize(count: int, singular: str, plural: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    if count == 1:
        return f"{count} {singular}"
    return f"{count} {plural or singular + 's'}"

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold=5):
        self.items = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku, quantity, unit_price):
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku, quantity):
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku):
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self):
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self):
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:

        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:

```bash
"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> list[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

"""Order processing pipeline."""
from .inventory import Inventory


def compute_tax(subtotal, rate=0.08):
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory, discount_codes=None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log = []

    def validate_order(self, items):
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal, code):
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items, discount_code=None):
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message):
        self.log.append(message)

            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

        self.log.append(message)

"""Order processing pipeline."""
from typing import Optional, Dict
from .inventory import Inventory


def compute_tax(subtotal: float, rate: float = 0.08) -> float:
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory: Inventory, discount_codes: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log = []

    def validate_order(self, items: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> bool:
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal: float, code: str) -> float:
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items: list[tuple[str, int]], discount_code: Optional[str] = None) -> float | None:
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log.append(message)
EOF

"""Reporting helpers."""
from .formatting import format_currency


def generate_summary(orders):
    total = sum(orders)
    count = len(orders)
    average = total / count if count else 0
    return {"total": total, "count": count, "average": average}

def generate_summary(orders: List[float]) -> Dict[str, Union[float, int]]:
    total = sum(orders)
    count = len(orders)
    average = total / count if count else 0
    return {"total": total, "count": count, "average": average}

def top_customers(customer_totals: Dict[str, float], n: int = 3) -> List[Tuple[str, float]]:
    ranked = sorted(customer_totals.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)
    return ranked[:n]

def format_report(summary: Dict[str, Union[float, int]]) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"Total: {format_currency(summary['total'])}",
        f"Orders: {summary['count']}",
        f"Average: {format_currency(summary['average'])}",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines)

"""Misc helpers."""


def chunk_list(items, size):
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]


def merge_dicts(*dicts):
    result = {}
    for d in dicts:
        result.update(d)
    return result


def flatten(nested):
    result = []
    for item in nested:
        if isinstance(item, list):
            result.extend(flatten(item))
        else:
            result.append(item)
    return result


def unique_preserve_order(items):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


def safe_divide(numerator, denominator, default=0.0):
    if denominator == 0:
        return default
    return numerator / denominator

"""Misc helpers."""


def chunk_list(items: list[Any], size: int) -> list[list[Any]]:
```bash
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]


def merge_dicts(*dicts: dict[Any, Any]) -> dict[Any, Any]:
    result = {}
    for d in dicts:
        result.update(d)
    return result


def flatten(nested: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
    result = []
    for item in nested:
        if isinstance(item, list):
            result.extend(flatten(item))
        else:
            result.append(item)
    return result


def unique_preserve_order(items: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


def safe_divide(numerator: float, denominator: float, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    if denominator == 0:
        return default
    return numerator / denominator
EOF
```

```bash
"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> list[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

from typing import TypedDict

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""


class ItemInfo(TypedDict):
    quantity: int
    unit_price: float


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: dict[str, ItemInfo] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

```bash
    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> list[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

```bash
"""Order processing pipeline."""
from typing import Optional, Dict, List
from .inventory import Inventory


def compute_tax(subtotal: float, rate: float = 0.08) -> float:
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory: Inventory, discount_codes: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log: List[str] = []

    def validate_order(self, items: List[tuple[str, int]]) -> bool:
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal: float, code: str) -> float:
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items: List[tuple[str, int]], discount_code: Optional[str] = None) -> float | None:
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log.append(message)
EOF
```

```bash
from typing import TypedDict

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""


class ItemInfo(TypedDict):
    quantity: int
    unit_price: float


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: dict[str, ItemInfo] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        if sku in self.items:
            return self.items[sku]["quantity"]
        return 0

    def low_stock_items(self) -> list[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

"""Formatting helpers for widgetkit."""
from typing import Optional


def format_currency(amount: float, currency: str = "USD") -> str:
    symbols = {"USD": "$", "EUR": "\u20ac", "GBP": "\u00a3"}
    symbol = symbols.get(currency, currency + " ")
    return f"{symbol}{amount:,.2f}"


def format_date(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> str:
    return f"{year:04d}-{month:02d}-{day:02d}"


def format_name(first: str, last: str, middle: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    if middle:
        return f"{first} {middle[0]}. {last}"
    return f"{first} {last}"


def truncate(text: str, length: int = 80, suffix: str = "...") -> str:
    if len(text) <= length:
        return text
    return text[: length - len(suffix)] + suffix


def pluralize(count: int, singular: str, plural: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    if count == 1:
        return f"{count} {singular}"
    return f"{count} {plural or singular + 's'}"

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold=5):
        self.items = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku, quantity, unit_price):
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku, quantity):
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku):
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self):
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self):
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())

"""Order processing pipeline."""
from .inventory import Inventory


def compute_tax(subtotal, rate=0.08):
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory, discount_codes=None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log = []

    def validate_order(self, items):
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal, code):
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items, discount_code=None):
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message):
        self.log.append(message)

"""Reporting helpers."""
from .formatting import format_currency


def generate_summary(orders):
    total = sum(orders)
    count = len(orders)
    average = total / count if count else 0
    return {"total": total, "count": count, "average": average}


def top_customers(customer_totals, n=3):
    ranked = sorted(customer_totals.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)
    return ranked[:n]

    lines = [
        f"Total: {format_currency(summary['total'])}",
        f"Orders: {summary['count']}",
        f"Average: {format_currency(summary['average'])}",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines)

"""Misc helpers."""


def chunk_list(items, size):
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]


def merge_dicts(*dicts):
    result = {}
    for d in dicts:
        result.update(d)
    return result


def flatten(nested):
    result = []
    for item in nested:
        if isinstance(item, list):
            result.extend(flatten(item))
        else:
            result.append(item)
    return result


def unique_preserve_order(items):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


def safe_divide(numerator, denominator, default=0.0):
    if denominator == 0:
        return default
    return numerator / denominator

"""Validation helpers for widgetkit."""
import re


def validate_email(address):
    if not address or "@" not in address:
        return False
    local, _, domain = address.partition("@")
    if not local or not domain or "." not in domain:
        return False
    return bool(re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", address))


def validate_phone(number):
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", number)
    return len(digits) in (10, 11)


def validate_zip(code):
    return bool(re.match(r"^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$", code))


def validate_age(age, minimum=0, maximum=150):
    return minimum <= age <= maximum


def validate_password_strength(password):
    if len(password) < 8:
        return False
    has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
    has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
    has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit

"""Validation helpers for widgetkit."""
import re


def validate_email(address: str) -> bool:
    if not address or "@" not in address:
        return False
    local, _, domain = address.partition("@")
    if not local or not domain or "." not in domain:
        return False
    return bool(re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", address))


def validate_phone(number: str) -> bool:
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", number)
    return len(digits) in (10, 11)


def validate_zip(code: str) -> bool:
    return bool(re.match(r"^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$", code))


def validate_age(age: int, minimum: int = 0, maximum: int = 150) -> bool:
    return minimum <= age <= maximum


def validate_password_strength(password: str) -> bool:
    if len(password) < 8:
        return False
    has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
    has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
    has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit

```bash
"""Misc helpers."""


def chunk_list(items: list[Any], size: int) -> list[list[Any]]:
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]


def merge_dicts(*dicts: dict[Any, Any]) -> dict[Any, Any]:
    result = {}
    for d in dicts:
        result.update(d)
    return result


def flatten(nested: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
    result = []
    for item in nested:
        if isinstance(item, list):
            result.extend(flatten(item))
        else:
            result.append(item)
    return result


def unique_preserve_order(items: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


def safe_divide(numerator: float, denominator: float, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    if denominator == 0:
        return default
    return numerator / denominator
EOF
```

```bash
"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: dict[str, dict[str, int | float]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> list[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

```bash
"""Misc helpers."""
from typing import Any


def chunk_list(items: list[Any], size: int) -> list[list[Any]]:
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]


def merge_dicts(*dicts: dict[Any, Any]) -> dict[Any, Any]:
    result = {}
    for d in dicts:
        result.update(d)
    return result


def flatten(nested: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
    result = []
    for item in nested:
        if isinstance(item, list):
            result.extend(flatten(item))
        else:
            result.append(item)
    return result


def unique_preserve_order(items: list[Any]) -> list[Any]:
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


def safe_divide(numerator: float, denominator: float, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    if denominator == 0:
        return default
    return numerator / denominator
EOF
```

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import TypedDict

class ItemInfo(TypedDict):
    quantity: int
    unit_price: float

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: dict[str, ItemInfo] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> list[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF

```bash
"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import TypedDict

class ItemInfo(TypedDict):
    quantity: int
    unit_price: float

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: dict[str, ItemInfo] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> list[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

```bash
"""Order processing pipeline."""
from typing import Optional, List
from .inventory import Inventory


def compute_tax(subtotal: float, rate: float = 0.08) -> float:
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory: Inventory, discount_codes: Optional[dict[str, float]] = None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log: List[str] = []

    def validate_order(self, items: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> bool:
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal: float, code: str) -> float:
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items: list[tuple[str, int]], discount_code: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[float]:
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message: str):
        self.log.append(message)
EOF
```

"""Order processing pipeline."""
from typing import Optional, List
from .inventory import Inventory


def compute_tax(subtotal: float, rate: float = 0.08) -> float:
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory: Inventory, discount_codes: Optional[dict[str, float]] = None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log: List[str] = []

    def validate_order(self, items: list[tuple[str, int]]) -> bool:
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal: float, code: str) -> float:
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items: list[tuple[str, int]], discount_code: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[float]:
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log.append(message)
```bash
EOF
```

```bash
"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import TypedDict

class ItemInfo(TypedDict):
    quantity: int
    unit_price: float

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: dict[str, dict[str, int | float]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> list[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import TypedDict

class ItemInfo(TypedDict):
    quantity: int
    unit_price: float

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: dict[str, ItemInfo] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

```bash
    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> list[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
```

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import TypedDict

class ItemInfo(TypedDict):
    quantity: int
    unit_price: float

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: dict[str, ItemInfo] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        if sku in self.items:
```python
            return self.items[sku]["quantity"]
```
```python
        return 0
```

```bash
    def low_stock_items(self) -> list[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import TypedDict

class ItemInfo(TypedDict):
    quantity: int
    unit_price: float

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: dict[str, ItemInfo] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:

        return 0

"""Formatting helpers for widgetkit."""
from typing import Optional


def format_currency(amount: float, currency: str = "USD") -> str:
    symbols = {"USD": "$", "EUR": "\u20ac", "GBP": "\u00a3"}
    symbol = symbols.get(currency, currency + " ")
    return f"{symbol}{amount:,.2f}"


def format_date(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> str:
    return f"{year:04d}-{month:02d}-{day:02d}"


def format_name(first: str, last: str, middle: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    if middle:
        return f"{first} {middle[0]}. {last}"
    return f"{first} {last}"


def truncate(text: str, length: int = 80, suffix: str = "...") -> str:
    if len(text) <= length:
        return text
    return text[: length - len(suffix)] + suffix


def pluralize(count: int, singular: str, plural: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    if count == 1:
        return f"{count} {singular}"
    return f"{count} {plural or singular + 's'}"

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold=5):
        self.items = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku, quantity, unit_price):
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku, quantity):
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku):
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self):
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self):
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import List

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float):
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int):
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import List

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float):
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int):
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())

"""Order processing pipeline."""
from .inventory import Inventory


def compute_tax(subtotal, rate=0.08):
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory, discount_codes=None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log = []

    def validate_order(self, items):
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal, code):
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items, discount_code=None):
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message):
        self.log.append(message)

            return None

        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:

"""Misc helpers."""


def chunk_list(items, size):
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]


def merge_dicts(*dicts):
    result = {}
    for d in dicts:
        result.update(d)
    return result


def flatten(nested):
    result = []
    for item in nested:
        if isinstance(item, list):
            result.extend(flatten(item))
        else:
            result.append(item)
    return result


def unique_preserve_order(items):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


def safe_divide(numerator, denominator, default=0.0):
    if denominator == 0:
        return default
    return numerator / denominator

from typing import List, Dict

"""Validation helpers for widgetkit."""
import re


def validate_email(address):
    if not address or "@" not in address:
        return False
    local, _, domain = address.partition("@")
    if not local or not domain or "." not in domain:
        return False
    return bool(re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", address))


def validate_phone(number):
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", number)
    return len(digits) in (10, 11)


def validate_zip(code):
    return bool(re.match(r"^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$", code))


def validate_age(age, minimum=0, maximum=150):
    return minimum <= age <= maximum


def validate_password_strength(password):
    if len(password) < 8:
        return False
    has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
    has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
    has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit

```bash
"""Validation helpers for widgetkit."""
import re
from typing import Optional


def validate_email(address: str) -> bool:
    if not address or "@" not in address:
        return False
    local, _, domain = address.partition("@")
    if not local or not domain or "." not in domain:
        return False
    return bool(re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", address))


def validate_phone(number: str) -> bool:
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", number)
    return len(digits) in (10, 11)


def validate_zip(code: str) -> bool:
    return bool(re.match(r"^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$", code))


def validate_age(age: int, minimum: int = 0, maximum: int = 150) -> bool:
    return minimum <= age <= maximum


def validate_password_strength(password: str) -> bool:
    if len(password) < 8:
        return False
    has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
    has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
    has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit
```

```bash
"""Reporting helpers."""
from typing import TypedDict, List, Dict, Tuple
from .formatting import format_currency


class SummaryDict(TypedDict):
    total: float
    count: int
    average: float


def generate_summary(orders: List[float]) -> SummaryDict:
    total = sum(orders)
    count = len(orders)
    average = total / count if count else 0
    return {"total": total, "count": count, "average": average}


def top_customers(customer_totals: Dict[str, float], n: int = 3) -> List[Tuple[str, float]]:
    ranked = sorted(customer_totals.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)
    return ranked[:n]


def format_report(summary: SummaryDict) -> str:
    lines = [
        f"Total: {format_currency(summary['total'])}",
        f"Orders: {summary['count']}",
        f"Average: {format_currency(summary['average'])}",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines)
EOF
```

```bash
"""Misc helpers."""
from typing import List, Dict, Any


def chunk_list(items: List[Any], size: int) -> List[List[Any]]:
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]


def merge_dicts(*dicts: Dict[Any, Any]) -> Dict[Any, Any]:
    result = {}
    for d in dicts:
        result.update(d)
    return result


def flatten(nested: List[Any]) -> List[Any]:
    result = []
    for item in nested:
        if isinstance(item, list):
            result.extend(flatten(item))
        else:
            result.append(item)
    return result


def unique_preserve_order(items: List[Any]) -> List[Any]:
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


def safe_divide(numerator: float, denominator: float, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    if denominator == 0:
        return default
    return numerator / denominator
EOF
```

```bash
"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import Dict, List


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, int]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

"""Order processing pipeline."""
from typing import List, Tuple, Optional, Dict
from .inventory import Inventory


def compute_tax(subtotal: float, rate: float = 0.08) -> float:
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory: Inventory, discount_codes: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log = []

    def validate_order(self, items: List[Tuple[str, int]]) -> bool:
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal: float, code: str) -> float:
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items: List[Tuple[str, int]], discount_code: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[float]:
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log.append(message)

```bash
"""Order processing pipeline."""
from typing import List, Tuple, Optional, Dict, Any
from .inventory import Inventory


def compute_tax(subtotal: float, rate: float = 0.08) -> float:
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory: Inventory, discount_codes: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log: List[str] = []

    def validate_order(self, items: List[Tuple[str, int]]) -> bool:
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal: float, code: str) -> float:
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items: List[Tuple[str, int]], discount_code: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[float]:
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log.append(message)
```

```bash
"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import Dict, List


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

cat > src/widgetkit/inventory.py << 'EOF'
"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import Dict, List, Union


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Union[int, float]]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF

This should fix the type errors because the inner dict's values are now Union[int, float], so "quantity" is int, and mypy will recognize that.

```bash
"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import Dict, List, Union


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Union[int, float]]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

cat > src/widgetkit/inventory.py << 'EOF'
"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import Dict, List, Union


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Union[int, float]]] = {}
```bash
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity
```

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> Union[int, float]:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

```bash
    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Union[int, float]]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

        else:

            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

```bash
    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)
```

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import Dict, List, Union


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Union[int, float]]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> Union[int, float]:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

```bash
    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""
from typing import Dict, List, Union


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Union[int, float]]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> Union[int, float]:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF

"""Validation helpers for widgetkit."""
import re


def validate_email(address):
    if not address or "@" not in address:
        return False
    local, _, domain = address.partition("@")
    if not local or not domain or "." not in domain:
        return False
    return bool(re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", address))


def validate_phone(number):
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", number)
    return len(digits) in (10, 11)


def validate_zip(code):
    return bool(re.match(r"^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$", code))


def validate_age(age, minimum=0, maximum=150):
    return minimum <= age <= maximum


def validate_password_strength(password):
    if len(password) < 8:
        return False
    has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
    has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
    has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit

"""Validation helpers for widgetkit."""
import re


def validate_email(address: str) -> bool:
    if not address or "@" not in address:
        return False
    local, _, domain = address.partition("@")
    if not local or not domain or "." not in domain:
        return False

    return bool(re.match(r"^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$", code))

"""Formatting helpers for widgetkit."""
from typing import Optional


def format_currency(amount: float, currency: str = "USD") -> str:
    symbols = {"USD": "$", "EUR": "\u20ac", "GBP": "\u00a3"}
    symbol = symbols.get(currency, currency + " ")
    return f"{symbol}{amount:,.2f}"


def format_date(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> str:
    return f"{year:04d}-{month:02d}-{day:02d}"


def format_name(first: str, last: str, middle: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    if middle:
        return f"{first} {middle[0]}. {last}"
    return f"{first} {last}"


def truncate(text: str, length: int = 80, suffix: str = "...") -> str:
    if len(text) <= length:
        return text
    return text[: length - len(suffix)] + suffix


def pluralize(count: int, singular: str, plural: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    if count == 1:
        return f"{count} {singular}"
    return f"{count} {plural or singular + 's'}"

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold=5):
        self.items = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku, quantity, unit_price):
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku, quantity):
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku):
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self):
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self):
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold=5):

"""Order processing pipeline."""
from .inventory import Inventory


def compute_tax(subtotal, rate=0.08):
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory, discount_codes=None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log = []

    def validate_order(self, items):
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal, code):
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items, discount_code=None):
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message):
        self.log.append(message)

"""Misc helpers."""


def chunk_list(items, size):
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]


def merge_dicts(*dicts):
    result = {}
    for d in dicts:
        result.update(d)
    return result


def flatten(nested):
    result = []
    for item in nested:
        if isinstance(item, list):
            result.extend(flatten(item))
        else:
            result.append(item)
    return result


def unique_preserve_order(items):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result


def safe_divide(numerator, denominator, default=0.0):
    if denominator == 0:
        return default
    return numerator / denominator

from typing import Dict, List, Union

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Union[int, float]]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
```bash
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

```bash
"""Order processing pipeline."""
from .inventory import Inventory
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple


def compute_tax(subtotal: float, rate: float = 0.08) -> float:
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory: Inventory, discount_codes: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log: List[str] = []

    def validate_order(self, items: List[Tuple[str, int]]) -> bool:
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal: float, code: str) -> float:
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items: List[Tuple[str, int]], discount_code: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[float]:
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message: str):
        self.log.append(message)
EOF
```

"""Reporting helpers."""
from .formatting import format_currency


def generate_summary(orders):
    total = sum(orders)
    count = len(orders)
    average = total / count if count else 0
    return {"total": total, "count": count, "average": average}


def top_customers(customer_totals, n=3):
    ranked = sorted(customer_totals.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)
    return ranked[:n]


def format_report(summary):
    lines = [
        f"Total: {format_currency(summary['total'])}",
        f"Orders: {summary['count']}",
        f"Average: {format_currency(summary['average'])}",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines)

```bash
"""Order processing pipeline."""
from .inventory import Inventory
from typing import List, Dict, Optional, Tuple


def compute_tax(subtotal: float, rate: float = 0.08) -> float:
    return round(subtotal * rate, 2)


class OrderProcessor:
    def __init__(self, inventory: Inventory, discount_codes: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None):
        self.inventory = inventory
        self.discount_codes = discount_codes or {}
        self.log: List[str] = []

    def validate_order(self, items: List[Tuple[str, int]]) -> bool:
        for sku, quantity in items:
            if self.inventory.get_quantity(sku) < quantity:
                return False
        return True

    def apply_discount(self, subtotal: float, code: str) -> float:
        pct = self.discount_codes.get(code, 0)
        return round(subtotal * (1 - pct), 2)

    def process(self, items: List[Tuple[str, int]], discount_code: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[float]:
        if not self.validate_order(items):
            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log.append(message)
EOF
```

            self._log("order rejected: insufficient stock")
            return None
        subtotal = sum(self.inventory.items[sku]["unit_price"] * qty for sku, qty in items)
        if discount_code:
            subtotal = self.apply_discount(subtotal, discount_code)
        tax = compute_tax(subtotal)
        for sku, qty in items:
            self.inventory.remove_item(sku, qty)
        total = subtotal + tax
        self._log(f"order processed: total={total}")
        return total

    def _log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log.append(message)

    return result

```bash
def flatten(nested: List[Any]) -> List[Any]:
    result = []
    for item in nested:
        if isinstance(item, list):
            result.extend(flatten(item))
        else:
            result.append(item)
    return result

def unique_preserve_order(items: List[Any]) -> List[Any]:
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for item in items:
        if item not in seen:
            seen.add(item)
            result.append(item)
    return result

def safe_divide(numerator: float, denominator: float, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    if denominator == 0:
        return default
    return numerator / denominator
```

```bash
from typing import Dict, List

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, int]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())

```bash
cat > src/widgetkit/inventory.py << 'EOF'
from typing import Dict, List, Union

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Union[int, float]]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

```bash
from typing import Dict, List, TypedDict

class ItemInfo(TypedDict):
    quantity: int
    unit_price: float

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, ItemInfo] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
EOF
```

from typing import Dict, List, Union

class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold: int = 5):
        self.items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Union[int, float]]] = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int, unit_price: float) -> None:
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku: str, quantity: int) -> None:
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku: str) -> int:
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self) -> List[str]:
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self) -> float:
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())

```bash
from typing import Dict, List, TypedDict

class ItemInfo(TypedDict):

class Inventory:

        else:

        if sku not in self.items:

        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
```

"""Validation helpers for widgetkit."""
import re


def validate_email(address):
    if not address or "@" not in address:
        return False
    local, _, domain = address.partition("@")
    if not local or not domain or "." not in domain:
        return False
    return bool(re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", address))


def validate_phone(number):
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", number)
    return len(digits) in (10, 11)


def validate_zip(code):
    return bool(re.match(r"^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$", code))


def validate_age(age, minimum=0, maximum=150):
    return minimum <= age <= maximum


def validate_password_strength(password):
    if len(password) < 8:
        return False
    has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
    has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
    has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit

    return minimum <= age <= maximum

    if len(password) < 8:
        return False
    has_upper = any(c.isupper() for c in password)
    has_lower = any(c.islower() for c in password)
    has_digit = any(c.isdigit() for c in password)
    return has_upper and has_lower and has_digit

"""Formatting helpers for widgetkit."""
from typing import Optional


def format_currency(amount: float, currency: str = "USD") -> str:
    symbols = {"USD": "$", "EUR": "\u20ac", "GBP": "\u00a3"}
    symbol = symbols.get(currency, currency + " ")
    return f"{symbol}{amount:,.2f}"


def format_date(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> str:
    return f"{year:04d}-{month:02d}-{day:02d}"


def format_name(first: str, last: str, middle: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    if middle:
        return f"{first} {middle[0]}. {last}"
    return f"{first} {last}"


def truncate(text: str, length: int = 80, suffix: str = "...") -> str:
    if len(text) <= length:
        return text
    return text[: length - len(suffix)] + suffix


def pluralize(count: int, singular: str, plural: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    if count == 1:
        return f"{count} {singular}"
    return f"{count} {plural or singular + 's'}"

"""Simple in-memory inventory tracker."""


class Inventory:
    def __init__(self, low_stock_threshold=5):
        self.items = {}
        self.low_stock_threshold = low_stock_threshold

    def add_item(self, sku, quantity, unit_price):
        if sku in self.items:
            self.items[sku]["quantity"] += quantity
        else:
            self.items[sku] = {"quantity": quantity, "unit_price": unit_price}

    def remove_item(self, sku, quantity):
        if sku not in self.items:
            raise KeyError(f"unknown sku: {sku}")
        if self.items[sku]["quantity"] < quantity:
            raise ValueError("not enough stock")
        self.items[sku]["quantity"] -= quantity

    def get_quantity(self, sku):
        return self.items.get(sku, {}).get("quantity", 0)

    def low_stock_items(self):
        return [sku for sku, info in self.items.items() if info["quantity"] <= self.low_stock_threshold]

    def total_value(self):
        return sum(info["quantity"] * info["unit_price"] for info in self.items.values())
